notes: Only the assigned scan 004 packet, its source images, the brief and the supplied notation snapshot were read. No other page, other reader output, external source, OCR, text layer or recognition service was used. No delegation was performed.

The first recorded UTC time (start_utc) was taken after reading the brief and textual packet and immediately before image inspection. Image-view timestamps are completion times returned in the same calls as the image views. The whole page was viewed once, half a once, then half b once. Each of the 20 derived tight crops was viewed once. No whole half was enlarged or re-opened, and no locus was recropped.

Coverage: the whole-image layout, upper number, sole opening display, full classification paragraph, Cas particuliers heading and all three examples plus Mac-Lane discussion, numbered section heading, full definition paragraph, complete final paragraph through the last word de, archive number, every local cancellation and interlinear addition, every underline, all eight pairs of quotation marks and all three blank references were inspected. Every text block and every inline/display formula was compared against BOTH witnesses, including agreements. This is a visual transcription coverage statement, not a mathematical proof check.

All C doubt macros were handled individually in changes. Retained: opening pi/K; cancelled e; curve after géo; cancelled s/x before Mac-Lane; s/comma after commutatifs; parenthesis/comma after kernels; overstruck or/rr in catégories; E-like undercapital. Resolved: let; établir; développées ici,; et; (Gr) before tensor-structure; final live 0-shaped index. C alert checks without a remaining doubtful reading (H degrees; ACU/AU; heading capitals; F/O/A/C-prime; Postnikoff; Anneau/groupoide; élement; Picards; double t in splittages) are recorded in notation or relevant changes, without manufacturing no-change rows.

H editorial content was considered. Its note already suggests the cancelled établir with express doubt, so that word is not called wholly absent. Its uncertainty about géométrique/direct is recorded as a doubtful placement locus. A bare add/emph/struck is not treated as a doubt flag. Formatting-macro renaming and absent generic handwriting tags were not counted as reading differences. Actual quote glyph changes, omissions and uncertainty-state changes were counted.

Hand identities are not established from this one-page packet; pen and pencil additions are conservatively called unnamed hand in the inventory. The words doit, développer and géométrique are regular typewriter impressions although their insertion apparatus includes pen strokes. Deligne in the first example reference is pen writing. The hook/connector apparatus is represented at its insertion attachment, not as a free-standing diagram.

The page states a classification by a group pi_0, a commutative group pi_1 with an action, and an arbitrary H^3 class; it describes a Baer-style geometric interpretation of the cohomology group law. It then states expectations/consequences for three examples. The Postnikoff comparison is phrased on doit retrouver, the novelty claim is only semble nouveau, and the geometric connection to Mac-Lane is expressly left to develop. These are reported statements, not results independently checked in this run.

The lower section defines a catégorie de Picard using ACU and an underlying (Gr)-category with AU tensor structure, then states strictness by identity of the symmetry on X⊗X and refers to Deligne. The last paragraph says pi_0 is commutative and acts trivially on the visibly 0-shaped index, then warns that a (Gr)-equivalence need not respect the commutativity constraints. The page ends mid-sentence after catégories de; no completion or full stop is supplied.

No targeted proof, independent re-proof, computation, formal certificate, or theorem-use recheck was performed. In particular the final target index was read from ink and was not normalized by an expected action on pi_1. math_checks is intentionally empty.

No diagram, independent drawing, letterhead, date, signature, address, archive stamp or explicit page total occurs. The lower pencil 3 is an archive annotation only. Small isolated specks in the margins have no recognizable textual or drawn structure and were not promoted to source content.

The report retains low-confidence underletters rather than inventing physically unreadable words or correcting the typed grammar. The underletter order at catégories and the semantic status of the géo line-end curve remain open; the main reader should adjudicate using the supplied crops. The final 0 is a final-form reading; dark retouching is noted without inventing a readable deleted 1.
